title: Journal Basket: Supporting Cross-Disciplinary Literature Searching and Methodological Transparency
abstract: arXiv:2610.30544v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Business students beginning a research project must learn how to identify relevant scholarly publications, distinguish disciplinary sources, construct database searches, and report the decisions behind their literature reviews. These tasks can be difficult because journal classification systems and bibliographic databases organize scholarly information differently. This paper introduces Journal Basket, a browser-based tool developed to help business students conduct journal-bounded literature searches and currently available in beta. Journal Basket enables users to construct journal collections from the Australian Business Deans Council (ABDC) Journal Quality List, choose from 42 business discipline presets, entire ABDC fields or the Financial Times FT50 list, apply journal rating thresholds, and generate search expressions for Scopus, Web of Science and Business Source. translated_title: 期刊篮：支持跨学科文献检索与方法论透明度
translated_abstract: 开始研究项目的商科学生必须学习如何识别相关的学术出版物、区分学科来源、构建数据库检索式，以及报告其文献综述背后的决策过程。由于期刊分类系统和书目数据库以不同的方式组织学术信息，这些任务可能颇为困难。本文介绍了Journal Basket，一个专为帮助商科学生进行期刊限定式文献检索而开发的基于浏览器的工具，目前已进入beta测试阶段。Journal Basket使用户能够从澳大利亚商学院院长理事会（ABDC）期刊质量列表构建期刊集合，可以从42个商科学科预设、完整的ABDC学科领域或《金融时报》FT50列表中进行选择，应用期刊评级阈值，并为Scopus、Web of Science和Business Source数据库生成检索表达式。用户还可以查看和修改期刊集合，下载…
tldr: 本文介绍了Journal Basket——一个帮助商科学生基于ABDC期刊质量列表构建期刊集合、生成多数据库检索式并进行跨学科文献检索的浏览器工具，同时提升文献综述的方法论透明度。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Journal Basket, a browser-based tool that helps business students build journal collections from the ABDC Journal Quality List, generate search expressions for multiple databases, and conduct cross-disciplinary literature searches with greater methodological transparency.
